Bring an at-home heat routine into your day with the Maxxus MX-K306-01-ZF HEM—a 3 person Near Zero EMF FAR infrared sauna crafted in Canadian Hemlock, featuring 7 carbon heating panels, chromotherapy lighting with a red light feature, and Bluetooth audio. Built for indoor use only, it runs on 120 V / 20 AMP electrical service and is designed for straightforward, clasp-together assembly.

Sized for a full three-person seating experience, this cabin pairs a warm wood interior with a clean exterior profile and a bronze tinted tempered glass door. The sauna includes both interior and exterior LED control panels, so you can adjust time and temperature without stepping inside first. When you’re ready to settle in, the roof vent supports comfort during longer sessions, while the oversize chromotherapy lighting system adds adjustable ambiance—plus a dedicated red light feature for your preferred in-sauna environment.

Heating is delivered through 7 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, specified as EMF under 3MG when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels. This layout targets a balanced surround-heat feel from multiple panel positions, helping you build a consistent, repeatable routine. For temperature expectations, the unit lists 118F–132F as the ideal operating temperature range and notes it can heat up to 140F.

To round out the in-sauna experience, the MX-K306-01-ZF HEM includes FM radio with Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection and built-in speakers. You also get exterior accent lighting for a finished look in a home gym, wellness room, or spare space. With a shipped configuration of 3 boxes, it’s designed to fit typical residential delivery and indoor placement needs (always plan a path to the final install location before delivery).

Maxxus focuses on infrared sauna cabins that combine carbon-panel heating, practical control layouts, and feature sets geared toward everyday home use. With dual control access, integrated lighting, and entertainment built in, the brand’s approach fits owners who want a dedicated indoor sauna space that’s easy to operate session after session—without adding extra accessories to get started.
